EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

S7 MaxV Ultra vs. S7 MaxV Plus
The Ultra bundle pairs the S7 MaxV robot with the Empty Wash Fill Dock. S7 MaxV Plus uses an Auto-Empty Dock; Roborock says its Auto-Empty Dock bags are not compatible with the S7 MaxV Ultra Empty Wash Fill Dock.
Robot filter vs. dock water filter
The white washable filter fits the robot dustbin. The Ultra dock has a separate water filter in its cleaning tank; the manual says to remove and wash it as needed and gives no scheduled replacement interval. Do not order a robot air filter for the dock.
Robot main brush vs. dock cleaning brush
The rubber main brush rolls under the robot to pick up floor debris. The small high-speed brush rotates in the dock's washing tray to clean the mop and move dirty water. They are different parts.
S7 MaxV Ultra vs. S7 Max Ultra
These are separate models. Roborock's comparison gives the S7 MaxV Ultra a 5,100 Pa S7 MaxV robot and the Empty Wash Fill Dock; don't assume every S7 Max Ultra kit or bag fits. Use the exact component fit stated on each card.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Washable robot-bin filterEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Rubber robot main brushEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Robot side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
VibraRise mop clothAfter each useEvery 3–6 months
Dock high-speed cleaning brushAs neededEvery 6–12 months
Dock disposable dust bagDisposableWhen full
Dock water filterAs neededNo scheduled replacement interval in the manual

Rinse the robot's washable filter with clean water only and leave it to dry for at least 24 hours. Keep a dust bag installed before the dock auto-empties. Remove and rinse the dock's high-speed brush and water filter as needed; they are separate from the robot filter and main roller.

Before you order

Which dust bag fits the Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra dock?

The linked original Roborock listing is a six-pack of 2.5 L disposable bags and explicitly names S7 MaxV Ultra. Roborock says the Ultra dock bag can hold debris for up to seven weeks, depending on use. S7 MaxV Plus uses an Auto-Empty Dock and different bags.

Does the S7 MaxV Ultra have two filters?

It has a washable air filter in the robot dustbin and a separate water filter in the dock's cleaning tank. The Amazon filter card is for the robot. Roborock's manual tells you to wash the dock water filter as needed and lists no scheduled replacement interval.

How often should I replace Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra filters and brushes?

Roborock recommends 6–12 months for the robot filter, main brush and dock high-speed brush, and 3–6 months for the side brush and VibraRise cloth. Clean the robot filter and main brush every two weeks, the side brush monthly, and the cloth after each use. Replace sooner if a part is damaged.

Are all linked Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra replacement parts genuine?

The filter, side brushes, mop cloth, dock bags and dock cleaning brushes are Roborock-branded listings sold by Roborock Technology Co. Ltd when checked. The rubber robot main brush is a Rrochio third-party part sold by MaiZG. We have not physically fit-tested third-party parts.

Can I buy the original S7 MaxV Ultra robot from the Amazon listing?

The Amazon page matched the Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra bundle, but it showed the item as currently unavailable on October 7, 2026. Check the current listing before ordering; availability may change.
